test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 2 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Four cows are tethered to the four corners of a square field of length 28 m so that each cow can just touch the two cows in the adjacent corners. If the grass in the area inside the square field that was accessible to the cows was enough to fee them for 22 days, for how many days would the grass that is beyond the reach of these cows be able to feed them if someone cuts it and leaves it inside the grazable parts? [Use π = 22/7]
solution:
**Given:**

Four cows are tethered to the four corners of a square field of length 28 m

Each cow can just touch the two cows in the adjacent corners

The grass in the area inside the square field that was accessible to the cows was enough to fee them for 22 days

**Concept used:**

Area of square = a² 

Area of sector = π r² (θ/360)

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7841b08d6578011483d3552cc53e228be83ff6a1dcd578c8b7947022ae4fc74b.png] 

Area of remaining part = Area of square field - Area of 4 sectors

⇒ (28)² - 4 × π × (14)² × (90°/360°)

⇒ 784 - 4 × π × 196 × (1/4)

⇒ 784 - (22/7) × 196

⇒ 784 - 22 × 28

⇒ 784 - 616 =168 m²

Area of the part that is accessible to the cow is 616 m² which is enough to feed for 22 days.

⇒ 22 = 616

⇒ 1 = 28

⇒ 1 × 6 = 28 × 6

⇒ 6 = 168

**∴ It is enough to feed for 6 days.**
